cohort: The study included 14,956 pregnant individuals with endometriosis and 16,911,497 pregnant individuals without endometriosis, identified from the 1999-2019 Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project, Nationwide Inpatient Sample.
finding: Endometriosis in pregnancy was associated with increased odds of various adverse maternal and newborn outcomes, including pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, placenta previa, placental abruption, preterm birth, chorioamnionitis, postpartum hemorrhage, growth restriction, and congenital anomalies.
